name: Revenue Enablement Bot
tagline: One front door for enablement asks, routed to the right specialist skill
description: A single point of contact for enablement leads, revenue-operations teams and the sales managers they support. You describe what you need, whether that is onboarding material, a playbook, a coaching plan or a process fix, and it works out which specialist skill from its openly licensed library should take the job.
author: Nathan
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
